notes: BETA 2.26.92 - everything from the v2.27 set plus the newest batch: the whole app is finally translated (2513 missing UI strings across 7 languages - no more English or Czech leaking into your interface), long races fixed (Le Mans Ultimate and rF2 time-left was read in the wrong unit, so a 6-hour race announced "one lap to go"; fuel warnings now re-arm after every refuel, stint plans go up to 40 stints, tyre-wear trend resets after a tyre change), and a brand new strategy engine that treats a timed race properly, picks the number of stops that is actually fastest (pit time vs a lighter car), evens out the stints and no longer fills the tank for the last one. Also in: 5 UI styles, male/female engineer voice, native track limits in every sim, Setup Advisor, community setups for ACC. Please report anything odd through the feedback form in the app.
